actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Google Text to Speech (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Google Text to Speech action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Google Text to Speech connection OAuth scopes: Scopes View and manage your data across Google Cloud Platform services

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: text_to_speech
actions.title: Convert text to speech
actions.description: Convert a text to a synthetic voice audio
actions.help: This action converts a text to a synthetic voice audio.

input.name: language
input.label: Voice language
input.hint: The language code of the converted audio (e.g. en-US ). Google supports some of the language codes listed here .

input.name: gender
input.label: Voice gender
input.hint: The gender of the synthetic voice.

input.name: encoding
input.label: Audio encoding
input.hint: Encoding of the audio content. Learn more
